title: How SellWhatPeopleWant turns a possible market gap into a testable decision
principle: A useful Opportunity Case shows the strongest argument for an idea, the strongest argument against it, and the cheapest evidence that should come next.

views.label: Whole case
views.title: From interesting idea to inspectable decision.
views.summary: The product is not a feed of business ideas. It is a bounded, evidence-backed, continuously correctable case that connects market evidence to execution and risk.

steps.title: Bounded question
steps.detail: Name the geography, time window, customer, proposed business, and decision the research must inform.

steps.title: Triangulated evidence
steps.detail: Combine behaviour, prices, alternatives, regulation, interviews, operations, and local context with their limits visible.

steps.title: Editable model
steps.detail: Expose costs, prices, capital, timing, assumptions, scenarios, and the conditions that break the business.

steps.title: Failure case
steps.detail: Seek contradictions, fragile assumptions, ruin scenarios, and evidence that would reverse the conclusion.

steps.title: Cheapest next test
steps.detail: Give the reader the smallest lawful and ethical experiment that most reduces uncertainty.

views.label: Evidence
views.title: Signals become useful when their limits remain visible.
views.summary: Statements, reviews, transactions, searches, shortages, and interviews may inform a case, but none becomes objective market truth by itself.

steps.title: Observed source
steps.detail: Capture what was actually observed, where, when, by whom, and under which selection conditions.

steps.title: Typed claim
steps.detail: Separate fact, sourced estimate, calculation, interpretation, hypothesis, and recommendation.

steps.title: Competing explanation
steps.detail: Look for alternative causes, contradictory cases, missing populations, conflicts, and jurisdictional limits.

steps.title: Inspectable conclusion
steps.detail: State what the evidence supports, what it cannot establish, and what new observation would discriminate.

views.label: Economics
views.title: Readers can change the assumptions doing the work.
views.summary: One forecast hides uncertainty. An Opportunity Case makes the operating model and scenario range editable.

steps.title: Operational inputs
steps.detail: Show price, volume, landed cost, labor, acquisition, working capital, financing, delay, loss, and cash cycle.

steps.title: Scenario range
steps.detail: Calculate base, upside, downside, and break-the-business outcomes without manufacturing precision.

steps.title: Fragile assumptions
steps.detail: Identify which variables control the conclusion and how much room exists before the thesis fails.

steps.title: Reproducible decision
steps.detail: Let the reader inspect formulas, change inputs, and understand why a conclusion moves.

views.label: Correction
views.title: Discussion improves a claim, not a popularity score.
views.summary: Participation belongs in the product only when it makes a claim, source, assumption, scenario, or local inference more accurate.

steps.title: Specific challenge
steps.detail: A contributor points to a claim, source, assumption, calculation, scenario, or unresolved question.

steps.title: Supporting evidence
steps.detail: The correction brings provenance, local knowledge, contradiction, or a real-world test outcome.

steps.title: Research review
steps.detail: Researchers evaluate relevance, conflicts, selection effects, and whether the case should change.

steps.title: Visible revision
steps.detail: The public case updates without erasing what changed, why it changed, or what remains disputed.

views.label: Decision value
views.title: The outcome is a better decision, including a disciplined no.
views.summary: A case succeeds when it reduces uncertainty or prevents waste—not when it merely attracts attention or produces a positive conclusion.

steps.title: Understand the opportunity
steps.detail: The reader can see the customer, gap, alternatives, economics, execution conditions, and decisive uncertainty.

steps.title: Compare the downside
steps.detail: Failure modes, recoverability, conflicts, and transfer limits are as legible as the upside.

steps.title: Choose the next action
steps.detail: Reject, adapt, investigate further, or run the smallest useful real-world test.

steps.title: Learn from reality
steps.detail: Outcomes return to the case so later readers can compare what happened with what the model assumed.
